run_photo_tracking_pyr: run coarse-to-fine photo tracking across pyramid levels to estimate camera pose and affine parameters
run_setup_reference: build image and depth pyramids with precomputed Jacobians for inverse compositional tracking
run_photo_level_tracking: run inverse compositional tracking at a single pyramid level to refine camera pose
run_precalc_jacobians: precompute Jacobians at theta=0 for inverse compositional photometric optimization
run_robustify_photo: compute robustified photometric residuals using Huber weighting for outlier rejection
